_about: Byte-level shapes of approaches the graveyard buried. graveyard-sweep.mjs matches each regex against the stage files with block and HTML comments stripped; one hit fails the gate. A burial without a byte-level shape stays a review item and is not listed. Add a signature with every burial that has one.

signatures.what: a capture-phase tap armed to retry a permission prompt (the next tap anywhere is stolen)
one platform's notification settings recipe shown to every platform
an existing push subscription reused without checking it was minted with the current signing key
a static manifest link in the head, chosen for one platform and swapped at runtime for the other
a service-worker registration that narrows or moves its scope in place
a carrying address built from the keys the phone saved, not the keys the page holds
signatures.note: the second alternative is the accepted base's own linkDeviceUrl, which the stage must wrap (rhCarryUrl) — listed as inherited for the base, a hit for a stage only if it is the sole carrying path; see sweep.mjs ALLOW

signatures.what: a name or identity written into the live address or shared storage to carry it into an installed copy
presence inferred from traffic instead of declared (a quiet partner goes dark)
